subject: Verify availability delta for 2028-05-22 21:00–21:18 UTC / request for post-incident plan
messages:
From: Kim Tran <kim.tran@clearriver-payments.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 May 2028 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: Unplanned availability delta affecting tokenization pipeline 2028-05-22

Markus / Laura,

We noticed an availability delta in our prod integration between 2028-05-22 21:00 and 21:18 UTC where ~12% of tokenization requests returned 503s or timed out; this impacted our checkout flow for ~6 minutes total. Per our SLA (section 4.2) we believe this qualifies for proportional remediation — could you confirm?

We've shared a short trace sample and a capture of front-end error rates. Please confirm the downtime window you observe and whether Redwood will consider a credit under our current plan. We're preparing internal exec notes and need an initial confirmation by EOD.

Thanks,

Kim Tran
Director, Platform Engineering
ClearRiver Payments
Attachments: checkout-errors_20280522.png (image/png), traces-sample.json (application/json)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Kim Tran <kim.tran@clearriver-payments.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 May 2028 15:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Unplanned availability delta affecting tokenization pipeline 2028-05-22

Hi Kim — thanks for the heads up and the artifacts.

Initial confirmation: our telemetry shows a regional routing fallthrough in us-west-2 that increased 5xxs for the tokenization microservice between 21:03 and 21:14 UTC (11 minutes), with a tail of elevated error rates through 21:18. That said, we need to reconcile the client-side retry behavior to compute an agreed availability delta.

Next steps from our side:
- Priyom will pull the raw ingress traces and KV-cache eviction logs for the window.
- Laura will run an SLO recompute using your traffic weights and return a provisional credit estimate.

Can you share the HubSpot case id or account usage link so we can tie the calculation to the right billing contract? We'll aim to provide an initial eligibility determination within 24 hours.

—Markus

Attachments: None

Subject: Re: Unplanned availability delta affecting tokenization pipeline 2028-05-22

Markus / Priyom / Kim,

I've completed a preliminary SLO recompute using ClearRiver's 95th-percentile traffic weighting. Results attached.
Summary:
- Observed service availability for tokenization (region: us-west-2) was 99.31% for the hour starting 21:00 UTC. Using the contract baseline of 99.9% this yields a proportional window consistent with a remediable event.
- Primary contributing factor: transient routing pressure caused by an autoscaler misconfiguration on a sidecar that started at 21:02 and self-healed after the autoscaler adjustment at 21:13. Logs show increased enqueue latency and a sequence of 503s from the tokenization workers at the same time.
- Evidence bundle attached: ingest-service-traces_20280522.zip

I'm including an initial credit ballpark: a single-month prorated credit equivalent to 0.58% of monthly invoice for affected tokenization throughput. This is provisional pending end-to-end reconciliation with your front-end error counts and retry behavior.

Action items:
- Kim: confirm HubSpot id or attach the usage dashboard link.
- Priyom: can you pull the correlated k8s evictions and LB route logs and add to the bundle?
- Markus: recommend scheduling a joint post-incident call tomorrow to align on remediation and final credit calculation.

—Laura

Attachments: ingest-service-traces_20280522.zip (application/zip), slo-recalc-20280522.csv (text/csv)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Kim Tran <kim.tran@clearriver-payments.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 May 2028 18:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Unplanned availability delta affecting tokenization pipeline 2028-05-22

Kim — thanks for the quick turnaround.

We confirm the observed window on our side (21:02–21:14 UTC with elevated error tail to 21:18) and agree it warrants further adjudication under the SLA. Next steps:
- Redwood will assemble a final evidence pack (logs, ingress traces, LB route snapshots) and deliver by 2028-05-25 18:00 UTC.
- We'll run the agreed SLO recompute with your usage weighting and publish a final credit determination by 2028-05-26 17:00 UTC.
- Proposed joint post-incident call: 2028-05-26 16:00 UTC — calendar invite to follow. Please let us know if that conflicts with your availability.

Priyom and Laura will lead the evidence pull; I will coordinate billing and the formal credit request through our contracts team. For tracking, referencing Jira INF-3248 is fine.

If you need an earlier confirmation note for your execs, tell me and we can provide a one-paragraph interim status.

Regards,

Markus Klein
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
